text: External census is 174 links into .opencode (56 .claude, 53 .cursor, 22 .devin, 19 .pi, 19 .codex, 2 .hermes, 3 specs), not 200; .pytest_cache absent in this worktree; brief's breakdown sums to 177. Internal .opencode links (excl node_modules) = 208: 203 in, 1 out (.opencode/specs -> ../specs), 4 broken.

All 174 external links are relative; no absolute link into this repo's .opencode. The only absolute .opencode-naming symlink points into a different checkout (048-crawlable-commit-history worktree) and is broken.

Five link shapes: whole-dir (.claude/skills, .pi/skills, .hermes/agents), filtered per-file commands (33 claude + 33 cursor), hook mirrors (21 claude, 18 cursor, 18 codex, 21 devin), per-extension (.pi 17), nested agents (.devin/agents/<n>/AGENT.md). .cursor and .devin agent links point at .claude/agents, not .opencode.

Asymmetry is deliberate: Hermes security scanner quarantines symlinked skill dirs (10 min/session whole-tree link; single cli-hermes link quarantined on 37 findings), so .hermes/skills holds generated copies; .claude/agents is a real fork because the agent dialect is lossy in both directions; Codex/Pi agent trees are generated dialect translations. Generators read .opencode paths: sync-skills-hermes.cjs (.opencode/skills/**/SKILL.md), sync-prompts*.cjs (.opencode/commands/**), sync-agents*.cjs (.opencode/agents/*.md), sync-runtime-mirrors.cjs constants at lines 39-41.

Hook mirror trees are discovery-only; execution uses literal .opencode/... command strings in .claude/settings.json (22 lines), .cursor/hooks.json, .devin/hooks.v1.json (bash -c cd DEVIN_PROJECT_DIR && node .opencode/...). If .opencode stays resolvable, JSON strings keep working untouched.

Only .claude/skills and .pi/skills expose the whole skill tree via link. Devin natively discovers .opencode/skills packets with no mirror — UNKNOWN whether its discovery traverses a symlinked .opencode/skills. Cursor has no in-repo skills surface; Codex none; Hermes consumes generated copies.

Eight links broken today: 4 in .opencode (2 changelog aliases, plugins/sk-vision.js -> unbuilt vision-runtime/dist/plugin.js, sk-doc validate-flowchart.sh) + 4 in specs scratch/archive pointing at other checkouts. Baseline before any nothing-dangles gate.

SYNC.md manifests already drift from disk: .claude/SYNC.md lists .claude/specs and .claude/changelog symlinks that do not exist; hook counts 18 vs 21 (claude), 15 vs 18 (cursor), 16 vs 18 (codex); agent counts say 13, disk has 12 + README.txt. Filesystem is the authoritative inventory.

noveltyJustification: First pass; corrected census (174 external/208 internal), relative-only finding, five link shapes, documented four-mechanism asymmetry, discovery-mirror vs execution-string split, manifest drift all new.
